description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Gilded Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Gilded Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Gilded Lotus and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
